Refresh, correct, and restore your skin with the VI Peel, a medium-depth, medical-grade chemical peel designed to improve overall tone, texture, and clarity. What Sets the VI Peel Apart in Non-Surgical Skin Rejuvenation?

Unlike traditional peels that may only work on the surface of the skin, the VI Peel is designed to reach into the dermal layers, stimulating collagen production and accelerating cellular turnover. It combines TCA (trichloroacetic acid), retinoic acid, salicylic acid, vitamin C, and other key ingredients to produce a comprehensive exfoliating effect that revitalizes dull, tired skin.

According to the Journal of Clinical and Aesthetic Dermatology, medium-depth peels like VI Peel are proven to improve acne, melasma, and hyperpigmentation with minimal risk, making them a popular choice among patients and providers alike.

How Can the VI Peel Improve Your Complexion?

This treatment is especially effective for:

  • Acne and acne scarring
  • Melasma and hyperpigmentation
  • Uneven skin tone and texture
  • Fine lines and wrinkles
  • Sun damage and age spots
  • Enlarged pores
  • Oily or congested skin

Safe for all skin types and tones, the VI Peel is a versatile solution that can be performed on the face, neck, chest, and even hands.

The AestheticEye Approach to Skin Clarity

At AestheticEye, we bring a medical and artistic eye to all skincare treatments. Under the leadership of Dr. Pargament, our team focuses on both safety and superior cosmetic outcomes. As a fellowship-trained oculoplastic surgeon, Dr. Pargament is uniquely equipped to understand the skin’s delicate structure, particularly in the eye and facial region, ensuring that your results are balanced, subtle, and natural.

Our licensed aesthetician works closely with each patient to customize the VI Peel formulation and ensure your skin is properly prepped and cared for post-procedure. This tailored approach allows us to target your specific skin issues for optimal improvement.

What to Expect During and After Your VI Peel

1. Preparation

Skin is cleansed and prepped to ensure even application.

2. Application

The peel is gently applied and remains on the skin for several hours.

3. Post-Peel Process

Peeling typically begins on Day 2 and continues through Day 5–7. Redness and flaking are common but manageable.

4. Aftercare

You’ll receive detailed at-home instructions and soothing skincare products to help your skin heal and reveal its fresh, new layer.

Most patients see noticeable improvements after one peel, though a series of treatments spaced 4–6 weeks apart may be recommended for more advanced concerns.

Frequently Asked Questions About the VI Peel

Is the VI Peel painful?

Most patients report only mild tingling or warmth during application.

How long does peeling last?

Peeling usually begins on the second day and resolves within a week.

Can I wear makeup after?

Avoid makeup until peeling subsides to allow optimal healing.

When will I see results?

Skin often looks clearer and more radiant by Day 7, with continued improvement in the weeks that follow.
